release_notes: Shops install this from the till update check. A signed-in Super Admin can void a receipt directly. Void requests can be opened, corrected, and returned. Audit records open with the details that were stored. A cashier can request a past-date sale, and a manager, admin, or Super Admin approves it once. Inventory search is by product name. Only an administrator can archive a product or deactivate staff. Dashboard sign-in accepts the shop hostname over https.
